insights.impact: Royalties get stuck in DSP reconciliation. 10-30% leakage is typical.
insights.example: We scanned a catalog: 12 tracks, CA$2,000 missing due to metadata gaps.
insights.fix: Clean metadata + align ISRCs across DSPs
insights.emotionalHook: You're getting streams but not getting paid.
insights.forensicOpener: Many catalogs quietly lose 10-30% of royalties due to unmatched ISRCs across DSPs.
insights.threadsLine: Your ISRC doesn't match your metadata? Your royalties are stuck in limbo.

insights.impact: PRO rejections, delayed payouts, works unable to be registered.
insights.example: In a recent scan, 8 works had missing publisher information.
insights.emotionalHook: Your PRO can't pay you if THIS is missing.
insights.forensicOpener: Missing contributors are one of the top reasons works get rejected by PROs.
insights.threadsLine: Missing writer or publisher on a work? That's an automatic PRO rejection.

insights.impact: Conflicts, disputes, delayed registration. Societies freeze payouts until resolved.
insights.example: We found 3 works with invalid share totals in a single catalog.
insights.emotionalHook: Your splits are costing you money.
insights.forensicOpener: Broken splits create conflicts that block royalties at the society level.
insights.threadsLine: If your splits don't total 100%, the society freezes the work. No payouts.

insights.impact: Global societies cannot match or pay the work.
insights.example: We scanned a catalog with 6 works missing ISWC.
insights.fix: Assign or request ISWC from your society
insights.forensicOpener: ISWC is the backbone of global royalty matching.
insights.threadsLine: Work with no ISWC = invisible to every society outside the US.

insights.impact: Registration failures, wrong writer attribution, no payout.
insights.example: We found 3 writers with invalid IPIs in a recent scan.
insights.fix: Update IPI + validate against CISAC database
insights.forensicOpener: Outdated IPIs cause silent registration failures across societies.
insights.threadsLine: Your IPI is the key to your royalties. If it's wrong, nothing pays out.

insights.impact: Double registrations, society conflicts, blocked payouts.
insights.example: We found a duplicate work blocking payouts in a 200-track catalog.
insights.emotionalHook: You might have duplicate works and not know it.
insights.forensicOpener: Duplicate works create conflicts that cascade across all societies.
insights.threadsLine: One duplicate work in your catalog can freeze payouts on the real one.

insights.impact: Lost international royalties. Foreign societies can't match your metadata.
insights.example: We identified €47,000 in missing royalties for a single Nordic catalog.
insights.fix: Align metadata across territories + register with foreign societies
insights.forensicOpener: International royalties are the most overlooked revenue stream in publishing.
insights.threadsLine: A Nordic catalog we scanned had €47k in foreign royalties just sitting there.

insights.impact: SoundExchange and foreign NR societies can't pay out.
insights.example: Artist missing $1,200 in SoundExchange NR payouts.
insights.fix: Add performer roles + align ISRCs with NR registrations
insights.forensicOpener: Neighboring rights are under-claimed across 40% of independent catalogs.
insights.threadsLine: If you're a performer, SoundExchange probably owes you money you've never claimed.

insights.impact: Zero royalties collected. Work is invisible to PROs.
insights.example: Artist had 4 unregistered works across 3 releases.
insights.fix: Register via your PRO + clean metadata before submission
insights.forensicOpener: Unregistered works are a preventable revenue loss with proper intake workflows.
insights.threadsLine: If your song isn't registered with a PRO, no amount of streams will pay you.

insights.impact: Payouts blocked because US, UK, and EU systems see different metadata.
insights.example: UK vs US metadata mismatch caused £3,400 to be held by PRS.
insights.fix: Normalize metadata + CWR-ready export per territory
insights.emotionalHook: Your metadata looks different in every country.
insights.forensicOpener: Metadata normalization across territories is the single biggest lever for global royalty collection.
insights.threadsLine: If your song looks different in US vs UK, the money gets stuck between societies.
